channel.title: MacPeek guides
channel.description: Practical guides for finding and understanding what is happening on your Mac.

item.title: How to Find What Is Using a Port on Mac | MacPeek
item.description: Find which process is using a port on macOS with lsof or netstat, read the output, and see the same answer from your menu bar with PortPeek.

item.title: How to Kill a Process on a Port on Mac | MacPeek
item.description: Kill the process using a port on macOS: find the PID with lsof, stop it with kill, escalate to kill -9 only if needed, and verify the port is free.

item.title: How to Free Port 3000 on Mac (Port Already in Use) | MacPeek
item.description: Fix 'port 3000 already in use' on Mac: find the process with lsof, kill it, or use a different port. Works for Node, React, Next.js and Rails dev servers.

item.title: lsof on Mac: Find a Process by Port (Cheat Sheet) | MacPeek
item.description: A practical lsof cheat sheet for macOS: find the process by port, list all listeners, filter by TCP or UDP, IPv4 or IPv6, and parse the output.

item.title: Mac Port Manager: See and Free Ports | MacPeek
item.description: What a good Mac port manager should do: list listening ports, show the owning process, kill safely and stay private. Compare Terminal, Activity Monitor and PortPeek.

item.title: Mac Port Monitor: Watch Listening Ports Live | MacPeek
item.description: Monitor which ports are listening on your Mac in real time: with a shell loop, or with PortPeek's live-updating list in the MacPeek menu bar app.

item.title: How to Find What Process Is Using a File on Mac | MacPeek
item.description: Fix 'the item is in use' and drives that won't eject: find which process has a file or folder open on macOS with lsof or Activity Monitor, and how to release it safely.

item.title: How to Check Monitor Refresh Rate on Mac | MacPeek
item.description: Find your Mac's real display resolution and refresh rate in System Settings or Terminal, and what to check when an external monitor won't run at 120 Hz.

item.title: See USB Devices and Check Their Speed on Mac | MacPeek
item.description: List the USB and Thunderbolt devices connected to your Mac with System Information or Terminal, read the link speed, and spot a slow cable or port.

item.title: Why Won't My Mac Sleep? Find the Blocker | MacPeek
item.description: Find what is keeping your Mac awake or waking it up using pmset: read sleep assertions, check the wake log, and fix the usual causes.

item.title: Check MacBook Battery Health and Cycle Count | MacPeek
item.description: Check your MacBook's battery health, maximum capacity and cycle count in System Settings, System Information or Terminal, and what the numbers mean.

item.title: How to Check Wi-Fi Signal Strength on Mac (RSSI) | MacPeek
item.description: Check your Mac's Wi-Fi signal strength, noise, channel and link speed with the Option-click menu, Wireless Diagnostics or Terminal, and how to read the numbers.

item.title: How to Find and Kill a Process on Mac | MacPeek
item.description: Find a running process on your Mac and end it safely: Activity Monitor, ps, pgrep, kill and killall, plus how ProcessPeek shows the details first.

item.title: Which App Is Using My Disk on Mac? | MacPeek
item.description: Find out which process is reading and writing your Mac's disk right now with Activity Monitor and Terminal tools, and how DiskPeek shows rates per process.

item.title: How to See Environment Variables on Mac | MacPeek
item.description: List and inspect environment variables and PATH on macOS in Terminal, see why GUI apps see different values, and inspect a running process with EnvPeek.

item.title: How to Check Your DNS Servers on Mac | MacPeek
item.description: See which DNS servers your Mac uses and test whether each one answers, with System Settings, scutil, dig and DNSPeek. Includes how to flush the DNS cache.
